LANTERN DUSK, FIRST LIGHTS: deep blue dusk settling over the rooflines, the first warm gold lanterns flickering on along the far bank, each one doubled and wobbling in flat pixel bands on the dark teal water below, shadows pooling soft and blue between the hulls

LANTERN DUSK, FULL GLOW: blue dusk deepened to indigo at the rooftops, a hundred small warm lanterns and lit amber windows burning along both banks, every one doubled and wobbling on the dark water in chunky stepped pixel reflections, soft blue shadow filling the gaps between

LANTERN DUSK, FAR BANK LIT: cool blue dusk across the near water, the far bank warm and gold with lanterns coming on in rows, each light wobbling below it in flat pixel bands across the dark teal surface, near shadows long and blue and soft

LANTERN DUSK, WATER ALIVE: full blue dusk, warm gold lanterns strung low over both banks reflected as a scatter of glitter breaking across dark rippled water in flat pixel steps, shadows between the hulls gone deep cool blue against the hundred small warm points of amber light

LANTERN DUSK, WINDOWS ON: blue dusk fading the rooflines to cool violet, warm amber windows and paper lanterns coming on all along the waterfront, each one doubled and wobbling in flat pixel bands on the dark teal water, blue shadow lying soft and wide across the whole near bank

LOW GOLD FROM ONE END: hot low late-afternoon sun pouring in from one end of the canal, the far bank half in warm honey gold and half in deep violet shadow, long blocky hull shadows reaching right across the bright jade water in hard pixel steps

LOW GOLD, AWNINGS LIT: hot apricot afternoon sun coming in low from the side, warm light catching the tops of the awnings and turning them amber while violet shadow fills below, the water carrying flat bands of warm gold and deep teal in chunky stepped pixel layers

LOW GOLD, SHADOW RACE: late-afternoon sun low and hot from one side, long violet shadows of the hulls racing across the bright gold water in hard-edged pixel steps, the lit bank glowing warm apricot against the deep teal of the shadowed near water

LOW GOLD ACROSS THE WATER: hot low sun coming in from one side of the frame, one bank burning warm amber and the other sitting in cool violet shade, the water between carrying flat pixel bands of gold where the light reaches and deep teal where it stays in shadow

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, JADE WATER: strong clean morning light high overhead, the water a bright saturated jade with hard-edged hull shadows in deep cool blue cutting across it in blocky pixel steps, deep cool shadow lying under the arcades, awnings glowing warm where the sun is behind them

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, AWNINGS: high morning sun behind the near awnings turning them warm amber and gold, the shadows they throw cool and hard-edged in pixel steps across the bright jade water below, deep blue-green shadow pooling under the arcade on the far side

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, HARD SHADOWS: clean strong morning light overhead, hard-edged cool blue shadows falling from the hulls across flat bands of bright jade water in chunky stepped pixel layers, the lit surfaces of the far bank warm yellow-white against the deep cool green of the shaded water

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, ARCADE SHADOW: high bright morning sun over the rooflines, the open water a saturated jade with hull shadows in cool blue cutting across in hard pixel steps, deep cool shadow under the near arcade dark against the warm amber glow of the sunlit far wall

FIRST LIGHT, PINK AND PEARL: early pink-gold light just cresting the rooflines, the water still pale and pearl-grey with the faintest rose tint across the flat pixel bands on the surface, one small warm brazier low on a deck casting amber against the cool grey of the water

FIRST LIGHT, MIST OVER WATER: soft pink-gold dawn light above the rooflines, the water pale and pearl below, warm rose touching the top edges of the far bank in chunky stepped pixel layers, one amber brazier glow low on the water doubling and wobbling in the pale surface

FIRST LIGHT, WARM BRAZIER: pink dawn light washing warm gold across the high rooflines and fading to cool pearl on the still water, one warm amber brazier on a low deck casting a small doubled wobbling glow in flat pixel bands on the pale cool surface below

WARM RAIN, LANTERNS EARLY: soft bright light under a warm grey sky, wet surfaces saturated with colour, the water dimpled and dark teal, warm amber lanterns already on and each one doubled and wobbling in flat pixel bands across the rippled surface, everything rich and colour-heavy

WARM RAIN, SATURATED COLOUR: bright diffuse light under a warm grey sky bringing every colour up full, the water dark teal and dimpled, jade reflections broken into a scatter of glitter on the ripples, warm amber lantern glow doubled below each light in chunky stepped pixel bands

WARM RAIN, WET AND BRIGHT: warm soft light through a grey sky, the canal water dark teal and dimpled with rain, lanterns burning amber and doubling in flat pixel bands on the disturbed surface, every awning and hull colour rich and saturated against the warm grey overhead

NIGHT MOON, SILVER ON TEAL: deep indigo night with a big soft moon low over the rooflines, its silver light lying across the water in flat pixel bands of pale silver-blue against dark teal, small warm gold lanterns burning along the banks, each one doubled and wobbling below

NIGHT MOON, GOLD AND INDIGO: deep indigo sky, the moon low and silver pouring pale light across the water in chunky stepped pixel layers, warm gold lanterns small and bright along the far bank, each doubled and wobbling on the dark water, warm gold against silver-blue and deep indigo

NIGHT MOON, LANTERNS AND SILVER: big soft moon above the rooflines washing silver across the dark teal water in flat pixel bands, small warm amber lanterns strung low over the canal, each one doubled and wobbling below in a scatter of warm gold glitter on the cool silver-lit ripples

STORM-BREAK, FAR BANK BLAZING: dark violet sky overhead, one bright hot break in the clouds letting hot apricot light fall on the far bank while the near water stays deep teal and the awnings on the far side blaze warm orange against the cool violet of the rest

STORM-BREAK, VIOLET AND GOLD: violet storm sky over the near water keeping it deep and dark teal, one bright warm break of hot gold light hitting the far bank and turning the awnings amber, the contrast between lit gold and deep violet shadow sharp in hard pixel steps across the water

STORM-BREAK, ONE HOT STRIPE: dark violet sky, one hot bright opening in the clouds sending warm apricot light across the far bank while the near canal water sits deep teal and cool, the lit awnings blazing warm gold in hard-edged pixel contrast against the violet shadow filling the rest
